_about: Coverage findings that are explained and expected. join.ts lists these under 'explained' in coverage.json instead of counting them as problems. Add an entry only with a reason a reader can check.

geometryWithoutResults.15005: Kalawao County, HI (about 80 residents) has no election administration of its own; its votes are counted in Maui County (15009).

stateSumMismatches.23: Maine reports overseas (UOCAVA) ballots statewide only, so its counties sum about 1% below the statewide total.
